gui.mcweapons.attachments.hint: Click to fit · G or Esc to close
gui.mcweapons.tuner.title: Gun Tuner: %s
gui.mcweapons.tuner.hint: Arrow keys step a focused slider
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.fire_modes.des: The trigger modes the gun has. Semi fires once per click, auto keeps firing while the button is held. The fire mode key (B) steps through them and Safe.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.rpm.desc: Rounds per minute: the fastest the gun can fire. Shots land on game ticks (20 a second), so in-between values work on average.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.damage.desc: Damage of a body hit. 2 is one heart; armor reduces it like any attack.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.headshot_multi: Damage is multiplied by this when a shot lands in the head.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.range.desc: How far a shot reaches, in blocks. Past it the bullet hits nothing.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.mag_size.desc: How many rounds a full magazine holds.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.chamber.desc: When on, reloading with rounds left keeps one in the chamber, so the gun holds the mag size plus one.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.draw_ticks.des: How long the draw animation is meant to last, in ticks (20 = 1 second). Nothing reads it in game yet.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.reload_ticks.d: How long a reload takes with rounds left, in ticks (20 = 1 second), before the rounds go in. The animation keeps its own length.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.reload_empty_t: How long a reload takes from empty, in ticks (20 = 1 second), including racking the slide. The animation keeps its own length.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.spread_hip_deg: How far shots can stray from the crosshair when not aiming, in degrees. Also sets the crosshair gap.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.spread_ads_deg: How far shots can stray from the sights while aiming, in degrees.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.ads_ticks.desc: How long raising the sights takes, in ticks (20 = 1 second).
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.ads_fov_multip: Zoom while aiming: the field of view is multiplied by this. Lower zooms in more; 1 is no zoom.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.move_speed_ads: Walking speed while aiming, as a share of normal speed. 1 is no slowdown.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.recoil_pitch_d: How far each shot kicks your view up, in degrees. It does not come back down by itself.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.recoil_yaw_deg: Up to how far each shot kicks your view sideways, randomly left or right, in degrees.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.recoil_push_ba: How far the gun model moves back toward you on each shot, in blocks. Looks only; aim is not affected.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.recoil_spring_: How fast the gun model springs back after a shot. Higher snaps back faster.
How quickly that spring settles. Low wobbles past the rest point, high settles without overshooting.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.recoil_max_kic: The most the model's kick can stack up during rapid fire, in shots' worth.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.sway_gain.desc: How much the gun lags and leans when you turn. 0 keeps it locked to the view.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.sway_max_deg.d: The furthest sway can lean the gun, in degrees.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.sway_follow.de: How quickly the gun catches up with the view after you turn. Lower feels lazier.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.bob_scale.desc: How much the gun and the view bounce while walking. 0 is steady, 1 is vanilla.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.field.breath_scale.d: Strength of the idle breathing and drift. 0 turns it off. Drops to a fifth while aiming.
gui.mcweapons.tuner.paste.none: The clipboard has no gun JSON
gui.mcweapons.tuner.paste.other: That JSON is for %s, not this gun
gui.mcweapons.tuner.saved: Applied and saved %s into the world
gui.mcweapons.tuner.failed: Gun Tuner could not write its file: %s
gui.mcweapons.tuner.reset.title: Reset %s to its defaults?
gui.mcweapons.tuner.reset.message: This deletes its saved values and reloads data packs.
